name: arun279-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins published by Arun Krishnamurthy, starting with codex-delegate for bounded Codex jobs.

plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate one coding task from Claude Code to Codex. A runner agent starts the launcher in the background and waits on that process until the job ends, so no Codex turn is bounded by a Bash timeout and the caller still gets one result. The launcher validates the live model pair, starts codex exec in a private process group, enforces a wall-clock deadline, reads the JSON terminal event, tears that group down, and returns the final message with reduced status. From a terminal it is one command that returns when the turn ends. Requires macOS, Python 3, and a signed-in Codex CLI. Prompts and files Codex reads are sent to OpenAI. Broad PreToolUse hooks inspect Bash, Monitor, and Workflow call text; the PermissionRequest hook is inert.
